name: uptimestatus Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free MIT/Apache-2.0 dual-licensed self-hosted uptime monitor and public status pages with HTTP, TCP, DNS, ICMP, database, gRPC and MQTT checks; incidents, 90-day status bars, email/webhook alerts and SQLite/PostgreSQL/Turso support. No vendor software quota or expiration documented.
watch_out: Requires your own server or Docker host, storage, HTTPS, backups and GitHub OAuth application for admin login. Email delivery and optional managed databases/object storage may cost extra. Protect encryption keys and admin credentials; the upstream describes this as a hobby project, so production readiness and scale require independent testing. No hosted infrastructure is included.
